description: This file defines the Cookie controller class for the common namespace in the Opencart Catalog module. It manages cookie-based user consent for cookies, including displaying cookie information and handling user confirmation actions.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Controller class for managing cookie consent notifications and interactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the cookie information page if applicable, including a message with a link to information page and options to accept or decline cookies.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to set user cookie consent preference and returns a JSON response indicating success.
